sentences.text:
Smt. Raj Kumari And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023
Author: Krishan Pahal

Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:145428
Court No. - 72
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 7648 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt. Raj Kumari And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Yadvesh Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants as well as Sri V.K.S. Parmar, learned A.G.A. for the State
and also perused the record.
2.

The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to FIR/Case
Crime No. 306 of 2016, under Sections 419, 420, 504, 506, 448, 120B I.P.C., P.S.- Bhelupur,
District- Varanasi.

3.  After arguing for some time, applicants' counsel submits that the present application for anticipatory bail may be disposed of with a direction to file a regular bail application which may be decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for the applicants.

5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference u/s 438 Cr.P.C.
The present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with a direction that the applicants shall surrender before the concerned court within one month from today and in case, a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
6.
For the period of one month from today or till the time of surrender of the applicants before the concerned court, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants- Smt.
Raj Kumari, Prem Chandra alias Prem Shankar Gupta and Amit Gupta, in the above case.
